Etherlords II: Skills

Hero skills of the game. A hero learns at most five, each up to rank 3.

9 pages. Select a name for its page.

  • Artificer
  • Channeling
  • Concentration
  • Learning
  • Luck
  • Regeneration
  • Resources
  • Strength
  • Suppression

Names, descriptions and values come from the game's own data.
